frozen_denominator.reconciliation: No discovery replay. All 21 frozen arXiv families were identity/date reconciled; exact v1 HTML was recovered for every family. Twelve retained families received source-specific full-text review and nine low-score families received identity/date/rejection closure. No unresolved access state remains.

full_source_reviews.title: Ring-Zero: Scaling Zero RL to a Trillion Parameters for Emergent Reasoning
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact v1 full text; author experiments, ablations and system implementation detail; linked slime repository is a training dependency rather than a paper-specific immutable artifact

locators.artifact: https://github.com/THUDM/slime (paper-linked dependency; no immutable Ring-Zero release established)

full_source_reviews.problem: Naively scaling zero-RL to very large models and long trajectories couples policy optimization to inference/training numerical mismatch, long-context communication, unstable low-probability-token updates and wasteful fixed reasoning length.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: Small-model RLVR with fixed context and ordinary importance ratios is reasonable when engine mismatch and communication depth are small. At trillion-parameter scale, low-probability amplification magnifies floating-point disagreement and context parallelism becomes a critical-path bottleneck.
full_source_reviews.mechanism: The pipeline combines clipped importance sampling, training-engine numerator correction, KL control, mixed-precision safeguards and context-parallel communication optimization; staged self-distillation/RL and length-conditioned modes separate discovery, sharpening and adaptive inference depth.
full_source_reviews.state_ownership_and_flow: The inference engine owns sampled trajectories and behavior logits; the training engine owns recomputed logits, ratios, gradients and policy state. The correction makes that engine boundary explicit rather than treating numerically different logits as identical. Length mode is an inference budget contract, not proof of intrinsic confidence.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: The design improves stability and sample efficiency but depends on costly large-scale infrastructure, math-verifiable rewards and proprietary 1T-model evidence. Joint length training produced negative transfer at the high mode, ultra-long high-quality data remained limiting, and 64K training context bounded the claim.

benchmark_contract.model: Ring-2.5-1T-Zero and 104B Ring-2.5-flash-Zero; distillation into Qwen2.5-32B and Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct
benchmark_contract.hardware: 320 x NVIDIA H200 GPUs for all disclosed paper experiments; this does not establish other training topologies or serving behavior
benchmark_contract.precision: mixed precision with explicit control; exact per-table precision must remain table-scoped
benchmark_contract.output_length: inference reasoning length reported per mode/benchmark
benchmark_contract.batch_or_concurrency: distributed training; serving concurrency not evaluated
benchmark_contract.baselines: frontier models on seven mathematics benchmarks plus internal stage/ratio/KL/length ablations
benchmark_contract.reported_result: Author reports competitive pass@1 and staged learning dynamics, with length-conditioned cost-quality trade-offs
benchmark_contract.claim_boundary: Does not establish general-domain RL scaling, causal emergence from parameter count alone, production serving efficiency or transfer beyond the disclosed models and math tasks

full_source_reviews.books_patch_proposal: In Ch31/Ch33 add a scale-induced systems branch: ordinary RLVR ratio -> separate inference/training engines create numerical identity drift -> corrected ratio plus KL and precision controls -> long-context communication optimization -> staged discovery/sharpening and conditional reasoning budgets. Preserve the small-scale/simple-ratio regime and state that length modes trade high-mode peak quality for query-dependent compute.

full_source_reviews.title: Function-Aware Fill-in-the-Middle as Mid-Training for Coding Agent Foundation Models
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact v1, method/evaluation/ablations/limitations and author repository
full_source_reviews.problem: Agentic post-training teaches interaction behavior but can erode base coding/tool capability; generic token masking does not target function-scale dependencies needed for repository edits.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: Standard FIM is scalable self-supervision and post-training is appropriate for action behavior. Repository-level agents introduce dependency-spanning edits and preservation constraints that call for a prior mid-training stage.
full_source_reviews.mechanism: Program-dependency analysis selects function targets under complexity/inferability criteria; the model reconstructs the missing function with generated rationale before existing agentic post-training.
full_source_reviews.state_ownership_and_flow: Corpus construction owns repository snapshots, dependency graph and decontamination; mid-training owns representation adaptation; post-training retains action-policy ownership. Evaluation must keep these stages separable.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: Gains require teacher-generated rationales and Python-focused repositories; cross-language support is indirect, only one non-Qwen2.5 family is tested, and modular function boundaries are assumed.

benchmark_contract.hardware: NVIDIA H100 80GB; full reproduction GPU-hours reported in appendix
benchmark_contract.precision: Not consistently disclosed across every evaluation table
benchmark_contract.output_length: Task-dependent; not a serving latency study
benchmark_contract.batch_or_concurrency: Three independent seeds for main coding-agent results
benchmark_contract.baselines: R2E-Gym, SWE-Smith, SWE-Lego and no-mid-training controls
benchmark_contract.reported_result: Consistent author-reported coding-agent gains and reduced capability erosion
benchmark_contract.claim_boundary: Python-heavy, teacher-dependent evidence; no universal coding-agent improvement claim

full_source_reviews.books_patch_proposal: Ch28: add objective granularity evolution from random spans to structure/dependency-aware function reconstruction, followed by behavior post-training. Emphasize that the mid-stage protects/reshapes capabilities but adds corpus, teacher and language bias; it does not replace SFT or agent evaluation.

full_source_reviews.title: A JoLT for the KV cache: Near-lossless KV cache compression via joint Lagrangian allocation of Tucker ranks and a rotated residual for LLMs
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact v1 with formulation, end-to-end evaluation, ablation and explicit deployment limitations; no author artifact linked

locators.artifact: No author implementation linked in v1

full_source_reviews.problem: Uniform quantization or matrix low-rank compression ignores distinct head/token/feature redundancy and allocates error independently across cache components.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: Quantization and per-matrix low rank remain simple and deployable. Long contexts make cache bytes the binding resource and create value in tensor-structured, layer-specific allocation.
full_source_reviews.mechanism: Partial Tucker compression preserves head/layer axes, compresses token/feature axes and encodes truncation residual through a JL rotation plus low bits; one Lagrangian dual jointly allocates ranks and residual widths under a byte cap.
full_source_reviews.state_ownership_and_flow: Offline calibration owns allocation parameters; runtime owns factors, residual and reconstruction. Storage accounting is not runtime savings until fused attention consumes compressed state without materialization.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: Near-lossless quality can cost decode reconstruction and transient memory. Cross-class byte ratios use conventions, long-context policy is validated only to 8192 tokens and calibration/domain robustness is incomplete.

benchmark_contract.hardware: NVIDIA A100 40GB for both disclosed model executions; a larger device is used only for the LLaMA RULER case that did not fit
benchmark_contract.precision: Model execution in bfloat16 and decomposition in float32; fp16 is only the idealized serialization/byte-accounting convention
benchmark_contract.reported_result: Author reports a compression-quality free zone on tested tasks
benchmark_contract.claim_boundary: No fused deployable kernel, broader model/domain sweep, multi-needle regime or production latency proof

full_source_reviews.books_patch_proposal: Ch45 already owns exact/main plus approximate/residual cache representations and the requirement that physical execution prove savings. Add only a review-note evidence pointer if desired; do not duplicate the mechanism until a fused kernel closes reconstruction/materialization cost.

full_source_reviews.title: KnowAct-GUIClaw: Know Deeply, Act Perfectly, Personal GUI Assistant with Self-Evolving Memory and Skill
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact v1, system/evaluation/ablation plus author release
full_source_reviews.problem: A general host Agent cannot reliably reduce cross-device GUI work to free-text handoffs or relearn successful action prefixes every session.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: Direct GUI policies are adequate for short single-device tasks. Long cross-application work makes state transfer, reusable validated skills and heterogeneous action routes first-class.
full_source_reviews.mechanism: Know–Route–Act–Reflect separates host orchestration from GUI execution, maintains attribution-aware memory and state-validated skills, and transfers typed blackboard data between applications.
full_source_reviews.state_ownership_and_flow: Host owns goal decomposition and route; GUI subagent owns perception/action loop; skill store owns validated reusable prefixes; blackboard carries typed observations, not narrative authority.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: Pipeline handoffs add latency and can freeze stale UI assumptions; benchmark evaluators and model scale constrain generality, and authors identify the rigid sequential planner as future work.

benchmark_contract.input_length: 117 MobileWorld GUI-only tasks from 201-task set; 50-step cap
benchmark_contract.output_length: Action traces; tokens separately reported where available
benchmark_contract.baselines: MobileWorld/AndroidLab framework baselines and system ablations
benchmark_contract.reported_result: Author reports 64.1% best selected configuration and transfer gains
benchmark_contract.claim_boundary: Benchmark/device/model-specific; not proof of open-world GUI reliability or safe self-modification

full_source_reviews.books_patch_proposal: Ch77/81/84 already separate derived memory, durable workflow state, typed tool contracts and platform authority. Retain as a bounded case; do not create a second GUI-agent architecture.

full_source_reviews.title: Tracing Agentic Failure from the Flow of Success
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact v1 with formulation, two-benchmark evaluation, ablations and limitations; no author artifact linked

locators.artifact: No author implementation linked in v1

full_source_reviews.problem: Step-level labels on failed Agent traces are costly and ambiguous; prompting a frontier model at incident time is slow and expensive.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: LLM judges and supervised failure labels are sensible for small offline audits. Persistent operations require a bounded detector that can transfer from successful traces to failures.
full_source_reviews.mechanism: A latent continuous-time trajectory model learns normal flow from successful traces; deviations on failed traces yield step attribution, with conformal detection controlling thresholds.
full_source_reviews.state_ownership_and_flow: Telemetry pipeline owns immutable steps and representations; detector owns anomaly scores; human/evaluator owns causal interpretation. An anomalous step is evidence for investigation, not proof of root cause.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: Success-only training removes failure labels but inherits representation and distribution bias; multi-error causality remains indirect and transfer was tested on only MCP-Atlas and Who&When.

benchmark_contract.model: Qwen3.5-27B MCP-Atlas trajectories and GPT-4o Who&When trajectories
benchmark_contract.hardware: Not sufficiently disclosed for universal latency claims
benchmark_contract.input_length: 203 public MCP-Atlas tasks; 88 behavior-caused failures after filtering
benchmark_contract.output_length: Step traces; prompt baselines report generated tokens
benchmark_contract.baselines: Prompted GPT-4o/other LLMs and supervised/representation ablations
benchmark_contract.reported_result: Author reports cross-benchmark F1/AUPRC improvements with lower inference cost
benchmark_contract.claim_boundary: Localization benchmark evidence, not causal diagnosis or production incident-resolution proof

full_source_reviews.books_patch_proposal: Ch69 add an evolution from raw trace search -> judge-based labeling -> success-manifold deviation detector, with explicit separation of observation, anomaly attribution and causal root cause. Preserve judge/manual review for novel distributions and compound failures.

full_source_reviews.title: HeteroMosaic: Exposing and Exploiting Heterogeneous Execution Opportunities for Energy-Efficient Edge LLM Inference
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact v1 with scheduling design, real-device microbenchmarks, ablation and discussion; linked runtime dependency is not an immutable paper artifact

locators.artifact: https://github.com/FastFlowLM/FastFlowLM (referenced runtime; paper-specific commit not established)

full_source_reviews.problem: Choosing one accelerator/backend per model misses dependency-preserving overlap across CPU, iGPU and NPU on unified-memory edge SoCs.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: Coarse placement is portable and avoids synchronization complexity. Unified memory and asymmetric accelerators make stage critical intervals, contention and device queues globally coupled.
full_source_reviews.mechanism: A heterogeneous roofline predicts opportunity; dependency-preserving microbatches expose overlap; trace-guided latency shaping jointly tunes assignment and schedule, with NPU-aware queues and custom GPU kernels.
full_source_reviews.state_ownership_and_flow: Planner owns task-graph partition and device assignment; runtime owns queues, synchronization and unified-memory buffers; traces feed re-optimization. Local operator speed does not authorize a globally greedy mapping.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: Overlap raises coordination and tuning complexity; results depend on SoC ratios, DVFS, contention and backend maturity. Benefits are bounded when one accelerator dominates or synchronization erases overlap.

benchmark_contract.hardware: AMD Ryzen AI 7 350, Ryzen AI 9 HX 370, and Ryzen AI Max+ 395
benchmark_contract.precision: Primary path uses AWQ W4A16; the cross-framework HeteroMosaic comparison uses BF16 and is not apples-to-apples
benchmark_contract.slo: Interactive latency/energy objectives; no external production SLO
benchmark_contract.reported_result: Up to 1.73x/1.78x selected speedups reported on balanced configurations
benchmark_contract.claim_boundary: Vendor/platform/model-specific; maxima are not fleet-wide guarantees

full_source_reviews.books_patch_proposal: Ch49 execution-plan section: extend single-backend lowering to heterogeneity-first critical-path scheduling on unified-memory SoCs. Explain why local fastest-device placement can lose globally, and preserve coarse placement when synchronization/tuning cost exceeds overlap.

full_source_reviews.title: MetaInfer: A Knowledge Only LLM Inference Engine Generator SKILL Toolbox
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact v1 with workflow, contract-knowledge model, experiments and limitations plus author repository
full_source_reviews.problem: Source-code-conditioned engine generation inherits general framework structure and cannot cover new hardware without continuously refreshed transferable constraints.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: Reusing vLLM/SGLang source reduces construction effort and remains safer for supported targets. Novel models/platforms require a compact execution path and explicit testable contracts.
full_source_reviews.mechanism: A contract knowledge base describes interfaces, shapes, state transitions and platform constraints; isolated implementation/review/verification agents synthesize and test a single-path engine, while controlled exploration consolidates successful new knowledge.
full_source_reviews.state_ownership_and_flow: CKB owns reusable contracts, source documents own provenance, generated code is provisional, and an independent verifier owns acceptance. Successful execution does not confer performance optimality.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: Coverage gaps, over-specialized consolidation and backend limitations can masquerade as code defects; correctness evolution still needs experts and a separate performance loop.

benchmark_contract.model: K100 main path Qwen3-8B, TP=4, greedy; Z200 Qwen3.6-27B, TP=4; A800 reference Qwen3-8B TP=4; Apple M5 Pro reference Qwen3-8B TP=1

full_source_reviews.title: ShortOPD: Recovering Pruned LLMs with Short-to-Long On-Policy Distillation
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact v1 with algorithm, generation evaluation, domain ablation, limitations and author repository
full_source_reviews.problem: Structurally pruned models can retain recognition scores yet collapse in free generation through demoted useful paths and repetitive suffixes; fixed long on-policy rollouts waste early recovery compute.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: Post-pruning KD is adequate off-policy when state distribution remains close. Generation exposes student-induced states, so the teacher must supervise trajectories the student actually visits.
full_source_reviews.mechanism: On-policy distillation evaluates a frozen pre-pruning teacher on student samples; repetition/truncation feedback and two EMAs shrink early horizons then restore long generation as recovery improves.
full_source_reviews.state_ownership_and_flow: Student owns visited states; teacher supplies dense token targets without changing; controller owns rollout budget only. Recovery corpus domain controls which behaviors are visited.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: The method reduces wasted suffix tokens but cannot recover unvisited domains; domain ablations sharply hurt corresponding capabilities and evidence is tied to depth-pruned models and disclosed tasks.

benchmark_contract.model: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 with about 25% of parameters removed by pruning the lowest-BI layers
benchmark_contract.hardware: Single node with 8 NVIDIA H20 GPUs
benchmark_contract.input_length: 45,447 training prompts; maximum prompt length 4,096 tokens
benchmark_contract.output_length: Maximum response length 4,096 tokens with short-to-long rollout scheduling
benchmark_contract.batch_or_concurrency: Training batch 64 with rollout group 8; no serving concurrency evaluation
benchmark_contract.baselines: KD, fixed-short OPD, fixed-long OPD and pruning controls
benchmark_contract.reported_result: Better free-generation recovery with fewer rollout tokens in author experiments
benchmark_contract.claim_boundary: Does not prove recovery for arbitrary sparsity, absent domains or production kernels

full_source_reviews.books_patch_proposal: Ch33 add post-compression recovery branch: off-policy KD -> on-policy state coverage -> adaptive horizon controlled by failure signal. Emphasize corpus coverage and the coexistence of KD for stable distributions.

full_source_reviews.title: PalmClaw: A Native On-Device Agent Framework for Mobile Phones
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact v1 with architecture/evaluation and author release; several hardware/model/evaluator fields remain scenario-scoped

locators.artifact: https://github.com/ModalityDance/PalmClaw/releases/latest (mutable latest pointer; event-time immutable release not established)

full_source_reviews.problem: GUI-only mobile agents turn high-level work into brittle long action sequences and grant broad interface reach without typed task boundaries or direct device-resource access.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: GUI automation is application-agnostic and remains necessary for unsupported apps. Native device tools become preferable when latency, permissions and resource access dominate.
full_source_reviews.mechanism: An on-device framework owns session loop, tools with typed arguments/results, shared/per-session memory and explicit execution boundaries; GUI remains a fallback branch.
full_source_reviews.state_ownership_and_flow: Mobile runtime owns permissions and device resources; Agent proposes typed calls; tool boundary validates; memory layers hold derived state while raw evidence remains separately attributable.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: Native tools improve speed and boundaries but require platform integration and narrower portability; remote model calls, permissions, stale summaries and mutable releases constrain reproducibility.

full_source_reviews.title: Oracle Agent Memory as an Enterprise Memory Substrate for Long-Horizon AI Agents
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact v1 technical report with lifecycle, LongMemEval/BEAM evaluation and explicit limitations; no immutable author implementation artifact
full_source_reviews.problem: Long-horizon memory is not just retrieval: promotion, scope, consolidation, revision/removal, evidence preservation and provider cache behavior interact.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: Flat history and vector retrieval are useful baselines. Multi-session enterprise workloads introduce governed scope, mutable facts and cost/latency constraints.
full_source_reviews.mechanism: A database-native lifecycle separates active context construction from passive scoped storage; it measures evidence retrieval, evidence use, task outcome and operational efficiency, with stable prefix/volatile suffix placement for cache compatibility.
full_source_reviews.state_ownership_and_flow: Raw messages remain evidence; extracted memories and summaries are derived, revisioned state; scope policy owns visibility; provider prompt cache is an external optimization, not memory truth.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: Compaction can lower estimated tokens but break prefix cache locality; broad retrieval raises recall and leakage/cost; benchmark aggregates hide construction versus retrieval versus reasoning failure.

benchmark_contract.model: LongMemEval uses gpt-5.5 xhigh with nomic-embed-v1.5 and HNSW top-K=200; flat-history pairwise judge is gpt-5.4
benchmark_contract.hardware: Database and hardware sizing Not Disclosed
benchmark_contract.precision: Not Applicable for hosted models; embedding precision Not Disclosed

full_source_reviews.books_patch_proposal: Ch77 already codifies source versus derived memory, lifecycle, scope, revision and evidence-use evaluation. Preserve as a vendor case and benchmark caution, not another mechanism.

full_source_reviews.title: Adaptive Filtering of the KV Cache: Diagnosing and Correcting Structural-Role Bias in LLM Inference
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact v1 with diagnostic analysis, adaptive method, ablation, counterexamples and limitations; no author artifact linked

locators.artifact: No author implementation linked in v1

full_source_reviews.problem: Accumulated-attention eviction can mistake delimiter, whitespace and repeated key scaffolding for semantically important state in schema-dense JSON/XML/table prompts.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: H2O-style heavy hitters are reasonable on prose-like corpora where attention mass tracks future utility. Structured prompts concentrate attention by syntactic role and break that proxy.
full_source_reviews.mechanism: The method labels structural roles, diagnoses attention allocation by role and applies adaptive role-aware correction before selection, retaining semantic leaves rather than structural scaffolding under tight budgets.
full_source_reviews.state_ownership_and_flow: Parser/role classifier owns structural labels; cache policy owns corrected importance and keep mask; attention remains an observation. Neither raw nor corrected score is semantic truth, and exact cache state is irreversibly lost after eviction.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: Role-aware correction improves schema-dense leaf QA but has a role-density floor, seed-sensitive margins and format-specific labeling artifacts. The masking harness does not compact tensors, so it proves accuracy of keep patterns, not memory or latency gains.

benchmark_contract.model: Primary Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct; cross-model Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, Phi-3-mini, and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct; Llama-3.1-8B base diagnostic
benchmark_contract.hardware: Single NVIDIA A100 80GB for the disclosed experiments; mask harness does not materialize physical cache compaction
benchmark_contract.input_length: Synthetic JSON, XML, markdown table and wiki-table corpora; cap policy tested at paper lengths
benchmark_contract.baselines: Full cache, H2O-like and Quest lower-bound comparison plus label/precedence ablations
benchmark_contract.reported_result: Author reports severe baseline collapse at low budgets and recovery on selected schema-dense corpora
benchmark_contract.claim_boundary: No real tensor compaction, latency/memory saving, 4-bit KV, production RAG/log workload or per-step Quest equivalence

full_source_reviews.books_patch_proposal: Ch45 add structural-role bias as a counterexample to attention-as-utility: prose heavy hitters -> schema syntax concentrates attention -> parse/role-conditioned correction -> require physical compaction benchmark before claiming systems benefit. Preserve H2O for prose and role-agnostic workloads; specify parser failure and role-density boundaries.

full_source_reviews.title: Harness Handbook: Making Evolving Agent Harnesses Readable, Navigable, and Editable
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact v1 with handbook construction, source validation, two-harness evaluation, modification taxonomy and ablations; project page linked, no immutable code artifact established
full_source_reviews.problem: As Agent harness behavior spreads across prompts, tools, runtime state and rare branches, coding models fail less from patch syntax than from locating all sites that jointly implement a behavior.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: Repository search and architecture docs suffice for stable modular systems. Fast-changing harnesses make documentation stale and behavioral ownership cross-module.
full_source_reviews.mechanism: The pipeline derives behavior-oriented handbooks from current code, connects high-level capability descriptions to candidate implementation locations and validates those locations against the repository before planning edits.
full_source_reviews.state_ownership_and_flow: Source code and tests remain authority; handbook is derived navigational state with revision identity; planner proposes locations; verifier rechecks against current source. A handbook never becomes permission to edit or evidence that a patch is complete.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: Handbooks reduce planner tokens and improve localization but cost regeneration, can omit dynamic/runtime behavior and may become stale. Evidence spans only two production-style harnesses and selected modification requests.

benchmark_contract.model: Read-only planner DeepSeek-V4-Pro; judges GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, and DeepSeek-V4-Pro
benchmark_contract.input_length: Terminus-2 and Codex repositories with 30 curated modification requests each
benchmark_contract.output_length: Edit plans; planner token use measured
benchmark_contract.reported_result: Author reports improved behavior localization and plan quality with fewer planner tokens, strongest on scattered/rare/cross-module changes
benchmark_contract.claim_boundary: Does not prove patch correctness, arbitrary repository transfer or safe autonomous harness evolution

full_source_reviews.books_patch_proposal: Ch81/84 add a maintainability evolution: raw repository exploration -> source-derived behavior map -> revision-bound handbook -> current-source verification -> edit plan/test gate. Treat handbook as derived state with invalidation, never canonical source; preserve direct search for small/stable codebases.

full_source_reviews.title: Evidence-Grounded Verified Agentic Reasoning: A Path Toward Eliminating LLM Hallucination in Empirical Inference via Tool-Attested Kernel Proofs
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact v1 full text with method, evaluation, limitations, and paper-disclosed artifact locator; repository commit was not independently fetched as event-time evidence

locators.artifact: https://github.com/7pocheR/eg-var/commit/88160519ce03dbd824f62799c1d3e1a02794a6e8 (paper-disclosed pinned commit; event-time artifact not independently fetched and not used as reviewed evidence)

full_source_reviews.problem: Tool access alone cannot enforce that accepted empirical claims descend from attested evidence or that deductions remain valid.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: Retrieval, tool calling, and natural-language checking remain reasonable for open-ended or low-risk tasks. Narrow high-stakes empirical domains with formalizable source schemas need a separate acceptance authority.
full_source_reviews.mechanism: Typed tool-attested leaves and curator-owned source lifts/axioms feed a proof object; only mkVerified constructs Verified, the Lean kernel checks the derivation, and failure yields Abstain plus a replay artifact.
full_source_reviews.state_ownership_and_flow: The source/tool owns observations; adapters own typed attestations; curators own source-lift and axiom scope; the LLM owns formalization/proposal; the Lean kernel owns proof acceptance; the evaluation or release gate owns publication. Kernel acceptance cannot upgrade source truth, attestation authenticity, lift semantics, or formalization faithfulness.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: Replayable provenance and deduction require domain formalization. Risk moves to attestations, lifts, whitelists, and the formalizer; open domains and ambiguous semantics still need retrieval or human review, and abstention is expected.

benchmark_contract.model: claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, and claude-opus-4-7 at temperature 0

2607.12395.title: Ring-Zero: Scaling Zero RL to a Trillion Parameters for Emergent Reasoning
2607.12395.artifact: https://github.com/THUDM/slime (paper-linked dependency; no immutable Ring-Zero release established)
2607.12395.delta: The pipeline combines clipped importance sampling, training-engine numerator correction, KL control, mixed-precision safeguards and context-parallel communication optimization; staged self-distillation/RL and length-conditioned modes separate discovery, sharpening and adaptive inference depth.
2607.12395.source_claim: The pipeline combines clipped importance sampling, training-engine numerator correction, KL control, mixed-precision safeguards and context-parallel communication optimization; staged self-distillation/RL and length-conditioned modes separate discovery, sharpening and adaptive inference depth.
2607.12395.analysis_old: Small-model RLVR with fixed context and ordinary importance ratios is reasonable when engine mismatch and communication depth are small. At trillion-parameter scale, low-probability amplification magnifies floating-point disagreement and context parallelism becomes a critical-path bottleneck.
2607.12395.analysis_tradeoff: The design improves stability and sample efficiency but depends on costly large-scale infrastructure, math-verifiable rewards and proprietary 1T-model evidence. Joint length training produced negative transfer at the high mode, ultra-long high-quality data remained limiting, and 64K training context bounded the claim.

2607.12463.title: Function-Aware Fill-in-the-Middle as Mid-Training for Coding Agent Foundation Models

2607.12463.analysis_old: Standard FIM is scalable self-supervision and post-training is appropriate for action behavior. Repository-level agents introduce dependency-spanning edits and preservation constraints that call for a prior mid-training stage.
2607.12463.analysis_tradeoff: Gains require teacher-generated rationales and Python-focused repositories; cross-language support is indirect, only one non-Qwen2.5 family is tested, and modular function boundaries are assumed.

2607.12550.title: A JoLT for the KV cache: Near-lossless KV cache compression via joint Lagrangian allocation of Tucker ranks and a rotated residual for LLMs
2607.12550.artifact: Not Disclosed — exact v1 provides no source locator for artifact; No author implementation linked in v1
2607.12550.delta: Partial Tucker compression preserves head/layer axes, compresses token/feature axes and encodes truncation residual through a JL rotation plus low bits; one Lagrangian dual jointly allocates ranks and residual widths under a byte cap.
2607.12550.source_claim: Partial Tucker compression preserves head/layer axes, compresses token/feature axes and encodes truncation residual through a JL rotation plus low bits; one Lagrangian dual jointly allocates ranks and residual widths under a byte cap.
2607.12550.analysis_old: Quantization and per-matrix low rank remain simple and deployable. Long contexts make cache bytes the binding resource and create value in tensor-structured, layer-specific allocation.
2607.12550.analysis_tradeoff: Near-lossless quality can cost decode reconstruction and transient memory. Cross-class byte ratios use conventions, long-context policy is validated only to 8192 tokens and calibration/domain robustness is incomplete.

2607.12839.artifact: https://github.com/FastFlowLM/FastFlowLM (referenced runtime; paper-specific commit not established)
2607.12839.delta: A heterogeneous roofline predicts opportunity; dependency-preserving microbatches expose overlap; trace-guided latency shaping jointly tunes assignment and schedule, with NPU-aware queues and custom GPU kernels.
2607.12839.source_claim: A heterogeneous roofline predicts opportunity; dependency-preserving microbatches expose overlap; trace-guided latency shaping jointly tunes assignment and schedule, with NPU-aware queues and custom GPU kernels.
2607.12839.analysis_old: Coarse placement is portable and avoids synchronization complexity. Unified memory and asymmetric accelerators make stage critical intervals, contention and device queues globally coupled.
2607.12839.analysis_tradeoff: Overlap raises coordination and tuning complexity; results depend on SoC ratios, DVFS, contention and backend maturity. Benefits are bounded when one accelerator dominates or synchronization erases overlap.

2607.13205.title: Adaptive Filtering of the KV Cache: Diagnosing and Correcting Structural-Role Bias in LLM Inference
2607.13205.artifact: Not Disclosed — exact v1 provides no source locator for artifact; No author implementation linked in v1
2607.13205.delta: The method labels structural roles, diagnoses attention allocation by role and applies adaptive role-aware correction before selection, retaining semantic leaves rather than structural scaffolding under tight budgets.
2607.13205.source_claim: The method labels structural roles, diagnoses attention allocation by role and applies adaptive role-aware correction before selection, retaining semantic leaves rather than structural scaffolding under tight budgets.
2607.13205.analysis_old: H2O-style heavy hitters are reasonable on prose-like corpora where attention mass tracks future utility. Structured prompts concentrate attention by syntactic role and break that proxy.
2607.13205.analysis_tradeoff: Role-aware correction improves schema-dense leaf QA but has a role-density floor, seed-sensitive margins and format-specific labeling artifacts. The masking harness does not compact tensors, so it proves accuracy of keep patterns, not memory or latency gains.
